issues: The backup module (src/lib/backup.ts) no longer exports createBackup, restoreBackup, or validateBackupStructure, causing TypeScript compilation errors and multiple acceptance test failures. This broke imports in many tests and UI screens. The missing exports must be restored or the code updated to match new API signatures.

Data reset photos deletion now throws a TypeError because src/lib/photos.ts accesses expo-file-system Directory and Paths directly, but on the test environment Platform.OS is undefined, leading to undefined reading of document path. The deleteAllPhotos function attempts to use Paths.document which is undefined in tests, causing failures in dataReset and acceptance test M5. Adjust deleteAllPhotos to guard against undefined Paths or mock Platform.OS correctly.
feedback: Restore backup functions and fix the photo deletion logic to handle web/testing environments without crashing.
